about: Queens is a regional municipality on Nova Scotia’s South Shore, amalgamating Liverpool with the former county around the Mersey River, Liverpool Bay, and inland lake country. Privateer-era Liverpool, coastal villages such as Port Mouton and Port Medway, and the road toward Kejimkujik National Park share one municipal government—not a single compact city. About 10,000 people live in the Region of Queens.
